- **RPA & Automação Distribuída:** Python (FastAPI, Selenium Headless, PyAutoGUI/UIA), Macro Manager (C#/.NET), UiPath, Automation 360, IBM RPA, Power Automate, arquitetura de RPA em microsserviços Docker.
- **DevOps, CI/CD & Observabilidade:** Jenkins (controladores e agentes/workers efêmeros em Docker), GitLab CI, Docker Compose, Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift, Nginx, Keycloak (OAuth 2.0 / OIDC), SonarQube, Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, OpenTelemetry.
- **Multi-Cloud, Dados & Mensageria:** AWS (EKS, ECS, Lambda, SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, Aurora, RDS), Oracle Cloud (OCI), Google Cloud (GCP / BigQuery), Azure, PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL, SQL Server, Redis, RabbitMQ.
- **Engenharia de Software, Legado & IA:** Node.js (NestJS/Express), React, TypeScript, PHP OO (Laravel, Yii2), Java, Flutter (Android/iOS/Web), LLMs, pipelines RAG, Multi-LLM Gateways, Docling IA.
